bridge.title: Four things I noticed

beats.title: 10.3K on Instagram, and a $7,500 mentorship behind a Buy Now button.
beats.text: Your site sells three packages: the Star Strategy for $550, eight weeks one-on-one for $1,999, and three days in person for $7,500, where you fly to the student. A $7,500 decision deserves a conversation. Right now it gets a button.

beats.title: All three Buy Now buttons open a signup form.
beats.text: Every Buy Now on redscorpionfx.com, including the $7,500 package, goes to “Create your account”. There's no checkout, no application and no call after it. Someone ready to pay you ends up with an empty dashboard.

stats.label: Buy Now buttons that open a signup

beats.title: The footer says ForexMastery, and the page promises a 98% success rate.
beats.text: The bottom of your site still says “© ForexMastery”, a leftover from the template, and the top shows “98% Success Rate”. The first makes visitors ask whose site this is. The second is the kind of claim that gets ads rejected.

beats.title: “I just built my site.” It stays.
beats.text: Your student dashboard, homework and journal stay exactly as they are. The funnel only sits in front of the mentorship: one page, a short application, a call where you decide who gets the $1,999 or $7,500 spot, and emails that get them to it.
beats.quote: “Join an exclusive mentorship built for serious traders.”

bridge.closing: So instead of explaining it, I built it. The page, the application, the emails and the ads, all below.

preCallEmails.subject: You're booked: here's what happens next
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Your call is booked for {{call_time}}. The link is in your calendar invite.

Before we talk:
1. Keep the time free.
2. Think about where you are: how long you've been trading, what you trade, and what keeps going wrong.

One note: nobody on my team will ever ask you to pay through a DM. Payments only happen through the official links from this email address.

Talk soon,
Devin

preCallEmails.subject: Why price action beats indicators
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Most traders add indicators when they lose. More tools, less clarity.

The mentorship strips it back: levels, patterns and one setup, the Star Strategy, with clear entry and exit rules.

On the call we'll look at where your process breaks today.

Devin

preCallEmails.subject: "Online or in person?"
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Eight weeks online works if you want steady weekly sessions next to your job. Three days in person is for when you want to go all in, fast.

You don't have to decide alone. That's what the call is for.

Devin

preCallEmails.subject: What we'll cover on the call
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

The call takes about 30 minutes:

1. Where you are now and what you've tried.
2. What you want your trading to look like in a year.
3. How the program works, what it costs, and whether it fits you.

If it isn't a fit, we'll tell you. No pressure either way.

Devin

preCallEmails.subject: Tomorrow: your call with Devin
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Quick reminder: your call is tomorrow at {{call_time}}.

If the time doesn't work anymore, reschedule with the link in your invite so someone else can take the slot.

See you tomorrow,
Devin

preCallEmails.subject: Today's the day
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Your call is today at {{call_time}}. Find a quiet spot and have your questions ready.

Talk soon,
Devin
